title: MpiMaskPreview - see where a mask lands on a plate, in one node
description: New node in the sibling repo ComfyUi-MpiNodes. Paints a flat colour through a MASK onto an IMAGE and previews it in-graph, replacing the EmptyImage -> ImageCompositeMasked -> Preview Image chain that mask debugging currently needs. Takes destination + mask only (no source), with widgets color / invert_mask / alpha / index. No x/y and no resize_source - it is a debug view, not a compositor. index picks one frame out of a batch so a clip does not render one thumbnail per frame. Ends in changelog.md + README.md rows and a push; the node_lock pin stays with the peer agent.
